profile.headline: Software Engineer at Cognizant
profile.summary: Backend-focused Software Engineer building RESTful APIs for healthcare systems with ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework, and SQL Server, plus hands-on Azure and CI/CD experience. Strong grounding in OOP and design patterns (SOLID principles), applied across projects to write maintainable and testable code.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•      Responsible for developing RESTful APIs for healthcare systems using ASP.NET Core (C#), Entity Framework, and SQL Server.
•      Developed and led a business testers team through validation and sign-off of a customer outreach and survey module, ensuring zero critical defects prior to production deployment.
•      Refactored legacy middleware pipeline to centralize exception handling, reducing unhandled 500 errors in production logs by 35%.
•      Built an EF Core data access layer against SQL Server using a DB First approach.
•      Collaborated and assisted with deploying containerized services on Azure, enabling auto-scaling during traffic spikes.
•      Participated in software design discussions, code reviews, and Agile development activities across several other projects under the same project umbrella.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.locationName: Parsippany, New Jersey, United States · Remote
positions.description:
•      Built a RESTful API in .NET to connect to internal Couchbase database servers, enabling users to switch between regional data sources using a single UI interface built with Angular.
•      Designed backend connection logic to handle authentication and data retrieval across distributed clusters spanning multiple geographic regions and sub-regions.
•      Collaborated with a team to deliver a working prototype by the end of the internship for potential production adoption.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
•      Co-built an on-demand 1-on-1 tutoring platform end-to-end with a small development team.
•      Led SEO strategy that grew organic visibility and user engagement for the startup.
•      Ran development using Agile Scrum and SDLC/STLC practices.
positions.insights: Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) , Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) and +6 skills

positions.title: System Analyst
positions.locationName: South Plainfield, New Jersey, United States · On-site
positions.description:
•	Addressed break/fix issues adeptly using PHP, SQL Queries, and COBOL, ensuring a comprehensive approach for effective solutions.
•	Monitored and resolved interface issues with expertise in Software Design, Documentation, Testing, and Maintenance, minimizing disruptions to operations.
•	Proficiently managed Database accounts for Invoicing and Billing, handling balances exceeding $5 million annually, demonstrating a keen understanding of Software & Hardware requirements.
•	Collaborated seamlessly in a Teamwork-Oriented environment, utilizing general consulting skills to enhance Problem-Solving efficiency with cross-functional teams.
•	Demonstrated a deep understanding of Software Architecture principles, contributing to the development of Scalable Solutions aligned with strategic goals.
positions.insights: Software Design, Software Architecture and +6 skills

projects.title: Automation Scripts
projects.description: I've crafted robust automation scripts leveraging both Python and Bash to significantly streamline my day-to-day operations. These scripts serve a multifaceted purpose, assisting in tasks ranging from organizing and maintaining systems to bolstering security measures. Through their implementation, I've achieved heightened efficiency by automating repetitive processes, enabling a smoother workflow, and ensuring a more robust security posture for my everyday activities.

projects.title: FitConnect
projects.description: In a mere 2-month agile environment, using Django and React, my team of 6 developers developed a fitness app connecting clients with coaches. Through seamless communication, clients hire coaches to achieve fitness goals. Employing Scrum methodology, we implemented robust testing with Selenium, ensuring reliability. Our CI/CD pipeline streamlined deployment. The collaborative effort resulted in a successful project, where technology met fitness aspirations in an efficient and user-friendly manner.
